questions.question: On level ground, the range of a projectile is maximum at a launch angle of
questions.explanation: R = u² sin 2θ / g; sin 2θ is maximum at 2θ = 90°.

questions.question: Distinguish a scalar from a vector quantity with one example each.
questions.answer: A scalar has only magnitude (mass, 5 kg). A vector has magnitude AND direction (velocity, 10 m/s east).
